# Camp Landau

> Camp Landau is a summer camp in Ramat Beit Shemesh, Israel, for English-speaking boys finishing grades 1 to 8. It describes itself as Beit Shemesh's #1 summer camp: days packed with sports, swimming, trips, Ruach, games, shtick and special surprises, run by Gishmak counselors. Its slogan is "The Most GISHMAK Summer of Your Life!"

## Key facts

- Who it is for: English-speaking boys finishing 1st through 8th grade
- Where: Sha'alei Torah, Nachal Sorek 16, Ramat Beit Shemesh, Israel
- Camp Director: Rabbi Yehoshua Landau, 02-999-6341 or 052-760-0897
- Also reachable: Mordy Landau ("Papa Mo"), 058-675-8475
- Email: Camp@Camp-Landau.com
- Next summer: camp is back on Sunday, August 15, 2027, at 9:00 AM
- Activities: sports (basketball, soccer, relay races, camp-wide tournaments), swimming, day trips across Eretz Yisrael (boats, amusement parks), Ruach (singing and dancing), games (trivia, scavenger hunts, competition days), Color War, shtick (performers, magic shows, game shows) and special surprises
- Music: Camp Landau has its own original camp songs, on Spotify and 24six
- STG, See the Good: a daily Dan L'chaf Zechus program. Campers watch a clip of someone doing something that looks wrong, work on judging favorably, then see what was really going on

- [Music](https://camp-landau.com/music): the original camp songs to play or download, plus Spotify, 24six and the music videos
- [STG, See the Good](https://camp-landau.com/see-the-good): the 7 See the Good episodes from summer 2026 and the theme song
- [Contact](https://camp-landau.com/#contact): phone numbers and email for the camp directors
